instruction:
You are a wastewater process engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-10 instrumented process control and valve package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. P&ID review, control valve sizing, loop scaling, and control narrative workflows shape the context only; this instance does not parse a real P&ID, vendor export, or authority-approved design.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-10-LH-04`
- P&ID: `PID-10-VALVE-04`
- Loop schedule: `LOOP-10-SCHED-04`
- Valve data sheet: `VALVE-10-DATA-04`
- Process range table: `RANGE-10-PV-04`
- Control narrative: `CONTROL-10-NARR-04`
- Instrumentation memo: `MEMO-10-INST-04`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Design flow | {{ design_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Specific gravity | {{ specific_gravity }} |
| Upstream pressure | {{ upstream_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Downstream pressure | {{ downstream_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Selected valve Cv | {{ selected_valve_cv }} |
| Total control-zone drop | {{ total_control_zone_drop_kpa }} kPa |
| Process LRV | {{ process_lrv }} |
| Process URV | {{ process_urv }} |
| Setpoint | {{ setpoint_value }} |
| Measured signal | {{ measured_signal_ma }} mA |
| Required fail-close time | {{ required_fail_close_s }} s |
| Actual fail-close time | {{ actual_fail_close_s }} s |
| Basin volume | {{ basin_volume_m3 }} m3 |

## Calculation Rules

- Required Cv equals `flow_gpm / sqrt(delta_psi / specific_gravity)`, where `flow_gpm = design_flow_l_s x 15.8503`.
- Valve authority equals valve pressure drop divided by total control-zone pressure drop.
- Command signal equals `4 + 16 x (setpoint - LRV) / (URV - LRV)`.
- Signal error equals the absolute difference between measured and calculated command signal.
- Fail-close margin equals required fail-close time minus actual fail-close time.
- Basin HRT equals basin volume divided by design flow, converted to hours.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when Cv margin, authority, signal error, fail-close margin, and HRT checks pass.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated modelling evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "required_cv": <numeric_value>,
  "cv_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "valve_authority_ratio": <numeric_value>,
  "command_signal_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "signal_error_ma": <numeric_value>,
  "fail_close_margin_s": <numeric_value>,
  "basin_hrt_hr": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-10 instrumented process control and valve template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one P&ID, loop, valve, range, control narrative, and memo source pack.

[meta]
name = "instrumented-process-control-valve-package"
description = "SSC-10 instrumented process control and valve metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound process control valve metrics from a deterministic SSC-10 task-owned source pack. The template combines valve Cv, valve authority, 4-20 mA scaling, fail-close timing, basin HRT, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "process-control-valve"
standards = ["P&ID review workflow", "control valve sizing workflow", "4-20 mA loop scaling"]
tags = ["mechanical", "wastewater", "instrumentation", "control-valve", "cv", "loop", "hrt", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.design_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "PID-10-VALVE-04 design flow"
min = 38.0
max = 38.0

[params.specific_gravity]
type = "float"
description = "VALVE-10-DATA-04 fluid specific gravity"
min = 1.02
max = 1.02

[params.upstream_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "PID-10-VALVE-04 upstream pressure"
min = 420.0
max = 420.0

[params.downstream_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "PID-10-VALVE-04 downstream pressure"
min = 255.0
max = 255.0

[params.selected_valve_cv]
type = "float"
description = "VALVE-10-DATA-04 selected valve Cv"
min = 145.0
max = 145.0

[params.total_control_zone_drop_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "CONTROL-10-NARR-04 total control-zone pressure drop"
min = 240.0
max = 240.0

[params.process_lrv]
type = "float"
description = "RANGE-10-PV-04 lower range value"
min = 0.0
max = 0.0

[params.process_urv]
type = "float"
description = "RANGE-10-PV-04 upper range value"
min = 60.0
max = 60.0

[params.setpoint_value]
type = "float"
description = "LOOP-10-SCHED-04 process setpoint"
min = 42.0
max = 42.0

[params.measured_signal_ma]
type = "float"
unit = "mA"
description = "LOOP-10-SCHED-04 measured command signal"
min = 15.2
max = 15.2

[params.required_fail_close_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "CONTROL-10-NARR-04 required fail-close time"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.actual_fail_close_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "VALVE-10-DATA-04 actual fail-close time"
min = 13.0
max = 13.0

[params.basin_volume_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "PID-10-VALVE-04 controlled basin volume"
min = 750.0
max = 750.0

[outputs.required_cv]
description = "Required valve Cv"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.cv_margin]
description = "Selected Cv minus required Cv"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.valve_authority_ratio]
description = "Valve pressure drop divided by total control-zone drop"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.command_signal_ma]
description = "Setpoint converted to 4-20 mA command"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.signal_error_ma]
description = "Difference between measured and calculated command signal"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fail_close_margin_s]
description = "Required fail-close time minus actual fail-close time"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.basin_hrt_hr]
description = "Hydraulic retention time through controlled basin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when Cv, signal, fail-close, and HRT checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc10_process_control_valve_case]
description = "Instrumented process control and valve source pack"
site_contexts = ["process-control-valve", "valve-loop-scaling-check"]

[archetypes.ssc10_process_control_valve_case.params]
design_flow_l_s = {min = 38.0, max = 38.0}
specific_gravity = {min = 1.02, max = 1.02}
upstream_pressure_kpa = {min = 420.0, max = 420.0}
downstream_pressure_kpa = {min = 255.0, max = 255.0}
selected_valve_cv = {min = 145.0, max = 145.0}
total_control_zone_drop_kpa = {min = 240.0, max = 240.0}
process_lrv = {min = 0.0, max = 0.0}
process_urv = {min = 60.0, max = 60.0}
setpoint_value = {min = 42.0, max = 42.0}
measured_signal_ma = {min = 15.2, max = 15.2}
required_fail_close_s = {min = 18.0, max = 18.0}
actual_fail_close_s = {min = 13.0, max = 13.0}
basin_volume_m3 = {min = 750.0, max = 750.0}

description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-10 process control valve package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc10_process_control_valve_case"]
